shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Plan faster without taking your hands off the keyboard.
shortcuts.enabledHint: When off, the page no longer reacts to single keys, for example during voice input. Undo and redo stay active.
shortcuts.altTip: Tip: Hold {{key}} to see the shortcuts right on the buttons. Letters and digits work while holding it, the others after releasing it.

settings.aiDescription: Three ways to create your session with AI.
settings.aiPrompt: Create a Sessionplan JSON for the described agenda. Follow the schema exactly at {{schemaUrl}}. The session is: [Describe your session here]. Return only a complete JSON object (as JSON file).
settings.aiManualIntro: Create the plan in the AI tool of your choice and import it here into Sessionplan in the right format.
settings.aiManualStep1: Copy the prompt and paste it into your chat (ChatGPT, Claude, ...).
settings.aiManualStep2: Paste the chat's JSON reply here or load it as a file.
settings.aiResponseError: The response is not valid Sessionplan JSON. Check the schema and try again.
settings.aiConnectIntro: Create a session and get the finished link directly in your AI tool.
settings.aiConnectClaudeDescription: Run these two commands in Claude to install the Sessionplan plugin:
settings.aiConnectClaudePromptExample: Build a 30-minute sprint retrospective and give me the Sessionplan link.
settings.aiConnectChatgptDescription: Open the Sessionplan plugin in ChatGPT. ChatGPT builds your session and gives you the finished link.
settings.aiConnectMcpDocsLink: Technical details of the MCP interface
settings.aiAgentIntro: Use a coding agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code, or an IDE skill)? Hand it this instruction and it will produce a clickable Sessionplan link for you.
settings.aiAgentBriefing: Read {apiDocsUrl} and use it to create a Sessionplan snapshot link for the following session: {description}. Return only the finished clickable link. Copy it verbatim from the API response — never reconstruct it yourself.
settings.clearAllConfirm: Really delete all data? This removes the current state, session history, all saved block templates, session templates, and your UI settings. The default templates will be restored.
settings.clearAllSuccess: All data and settings deleted and reset to defaults

planner.readOnlyChangesRequest: Ask the person who sent you the link for the editor link, or create your own local copy.

planner.closeSessionConfirmText: You have changes that haven't been synced with the dynamic link yet. If you close now, they'll be lost.

planner.syncRejectedHint: Your changes were not saved, for example because the plan is too large. Download it so you don't lose anything.
